surface_name: Multi-source databases on older API versions
title: Integration on an older Notion-Version breaks once someone adds a second data source to a database
symptoms: validation_error when retrieving a database that worked the day before
Creating a page with a database_id parent starts failing
The database drops out of search results for the integration
cause: Versions before 2025-09-03 assume one schema per database. When a user adds a second data source in the UI, reads, writes, queries and relation writes against that database can no longer tell which source is meant and fail.
fix: Move the integration to Notion-Version 2025-09-03 or later and address data sources by ID. Page creation with a data_source_id parent works on every version, so switch that first.
affected: Integrations pinned to Notion-Version 2022-06-28 or earlier, from the September 2025 multi-source rollout onward
